# Getting and activating your nsave card


nsave team


Jan 11, 2026


Order your card from the app, follow its delivery progress and activate it only after it arrives.


## Order and track your card


Wide card artwork used to check image spacing against nearby headings and lists.


## Activate it in the app


- Open Cards and choose the card that has arrived.
- Check that the final four digits match the physical card.
- Choose Activate card and set your PIN.
